title: Neon Midnight
style: English, synth-pop, androgynous vocal, cool and airy, vintage analog synths, gated drums and chorus guitar, neon nocturnal, glossy 1980s production, 118 BPM
lyrics:
[Intro]
Streetlight buzzes like it's nervous
Payphone's dead but I still dial

[Verse 1]
Rolled the window down on the overpass
Radio caught a station out of nowhere
Somebody's heartbreak in a major key
Your jacket smells like gasoline and mint
We split a pretzel at the arcade door
You lost three times and blamed the joystick
I let you win the fourth, you never knew
The ticket machine ate my last two coins

[Pre-Chorus]
The city doesn't sleep, it just pretends
Turns the lights down low and waits for us
And every siren sounds like a downbeat
Every downbeat sounds like go

[Chorus]
Neon midnight, running on the wet asphalt
Neon midnight, our names in the arcade glass
We got no plan and half a tank
And the night keeps handing us more
Neon midnight, don't let the sun catch up
Neon midnight

[Verse 2]
Past the laundromat, past the pawn shop sign
Your reflection in the bus stop glass
Knew a different version of me
We took the stairs instead of the escalator
Counted eighty-four steps, lost count at seventy
Somewhere a rooftop party spilled its bass
Onto the street like it couldn't help itself
You said the best songs are the ones you can't hear right

[Pre-Chorus]
The city doesn't sleep, it just pretends
Turns the lights down low and waits for us
And every siren sounds like a downbeat
Every downbeat sounds like go

[Chorus]
Neon midnight, running on the wet asphalt
Neon midnight, our names in the arcade glass
We got no plan and half a tank
And the night keeps handing us more
Neon midnight, don't let the sun catch up
Neon midnight

[Bridge]
Maybe tomorrow I'll be practical
Pay the rent, take the earlier train
But tonight the parking meters are off
And the crosswalk's blinking just for us
Just for us, just for us

[Verse 3]
Your hand in my pocket, both of us cold
We bought two coffees and forgot to drink them
Sat on the hood till the fog rolled in
Talking about nothing like it mattered
A cabbie asked us where we were headed
We pointed at the skyline and he laughed

[Outro]
Streetlight stutters, then burns out
Payphone's dead, but I still dial
Still dial
cover_prompt: neon midnight city street, wet asphalt reflections, arcade glow, chrome and magenta, 9:16 vertical
